'''Herald of Bloodgouge''' was the herald of the fearsome [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] chieftain [[Bloodgouge]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Bloodgouge and his Herald<ref name="TotC" /> were killed by Imperials when the chief began marshaling his people for an attack on [[Outpost Rennar]].<ref name="BandS">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Blood and Sand|Tatooine}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Herald of Bloodgouge appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial mission "Test of the Clan" on Tatooine.<ref name="TotC" />
